scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The proof combines a published four-mode Gaussian-fidelity normal form with a published exact convolution-purity formula and an elementary one-variable optimization. The numerical artifact only corroborates the convolution normalization.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Pure positive-parity states of four complex fermionic modes; order-two magic Renyi entropy only. No mixed-state, higher-order, or higher-mode optimality claim.

title: Exact four-mode magic Rényi entropy from Gaussian fidelity
